meta.name: project
meta.description: GitHub Issues as PLAN.md replacement — agents read/update them. Auto-invoke on issue-linked branches. Triggers "what's the plan", "project status", "sync with github", "close the issue".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将GitHub Issues作为计划文档，由AI自动读写同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用GitHub Issues管理任务并希望AI自动更新状态
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub Issues into a live plan that AI reads and updates automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage tasks with GitHub Issues and want AI to keep them in sync

howto.what: 当你在当前 Git 分支上工作时，Claude 会自动读取关联的 GitHub Issue 作为计划，并在你完成任务后更新 Issue 的进度、勾选待办项。它也能帮你创建新 Issue、查看项目看板。
howto.when: 当你进入一个与 GitHub Issue 关联的分支时自动触发，或者当你说出“what's the plan”、“project status”、“sync with github”等关键词时。

say.note: Claude 会读取当前 Issue 并总结任务列表。
Claude 会列出你负责的未关闭 Issue 及进度。
Claude 会将当前工作进度同步到 Issue 的评论中。

howto.what_en: When you work on a branch linked to a GitHub Issue, Claude automatically reads the issue as a plan and updates its progress and checkboxes when tasks are done. It can also create issues and view project boards.
howto.when_en: Auto-invoked when you enter a branch with a linked issue, or when you say phrases like "what's the plan", "project status", "sync with github".

say_en.note: Claude reads the current issue and summarizes tasks.
Claude lists your open issues and their progress.
Claude comments on the issue with current progress.
